title: Topical Investigations; Strength & Conditioning of Athletes
description: KNES389P prepares students to teach and coach athletes in the area of strength and conditioning. The lecture content is paired with hands-on skills practice to address safety screening, pre- and post- testing, and multi-modal training methods. Students will prepare to work with athletes at any level and age range, in individual or group settings, with a variety of sports applications, and in a variety of training locations.
